title: Your own dynamic array
description:
Write a growing array and count how often it copies.

```
pushed 1000 items, capacity 1024, 11 reallocations, 1023 element copies
average copies per push: 1.02
```
hints: When `m_size == m_capacity`, make a new array of `std::max<std::size_t>(1, m_capacity * 2)`, copy the old items across, then move the pointer in (lesson 1.03).
Count copies inside the copy loop.
requirements: Double the capacity when full (start at 1).
Count reallocations and copied elements, and show the average stays small (amortised O(1)).
stretch: Grow by 1.5 times instead and compare the numbers.
